description: Combine calendar events, routines, and upcoming bills into one prioritized daily task list

system_context.engine_import: from engine.base import SkillBase, SkillRequest, SkillResponse

mandatory_patterns.no_database: Composite. No _get_conn. Uses importlib to call sub-skills.
mandatory_patterns.import_pattern: module = importlib.import_module(path); cls = getattr(module, name); response = await cls().run(request)
mandatory_patterns.skillresponse_signature: SkillResponse ONLY accepts: skill_name, data, summary, confidence, sources, error.
mandatory_patterns.async_required: CRITICAL: execute() MUST be 'async def execute'. _run_skill() MUST be 'async def _run_skill'. All .run() calls MUST use 'await'. Every method that calls await must itself be async def.

build_plan.instruction:
Write file skeleton. Imports: logging, importlib, engine.base (SkillBase, SkillRequest, SkillResponse). NO database imports. Class DailyTaskPlannerSkill with name='daily_task_planner', triggers=['task planner', 'plan my day', 'what should i do', 'daily plan', 'prioritize my day', 'to do list', 'todo list', 'whats on my plate']. Define SUB_SKILLS dict:

SUB_SKILLS = {
    'calendar': ('data.query_calendar', 'QueryCalendarSkill'),
    'routines': ('data.query_routines', 'QueryRoutinesSkill'),
    'bills': ('data.query_bills_due', 'QueryBillsDueSkill'),
}

Methods: async def execute, async def _run_skill, def _build_plan. All have 'pass'. ASCII only.

Implement 'async def _run_skill(self, module_path, class_name, request)'. Use importlib.import_module(module_path). cls = getattr(module, class_name). response = await cls().run(request). Return response. Wrap in try/except, on error return SkillResponse(skill_name=class_name, error=str(e)).

Implement def _build_plan(self, results). Takes dict of {label: SkillResponse}. Build a prioritized task list. Priority order: 1) Calendar events with times (highest - time-sensitive), 2) Incomplete routines (medium - daily habits), 3) Bills due today or tomorrow (medium-high - financial), 4) Bills due this week (lower). For each section, extract items from the response.data if available. Build a numbered list: '1. [HIGH] Event: title at time\n2. [MED] Routine: title\n3. [MED] Bill: merchant $amount due day N'. Also count: total tasks, completed routines, upcoming events. Return summary string.

Implement 'async def execute(self, request)'. For each skill in SUB_SKILLS: response = await self._run_skill(mod_path, cls_name, request). Collect in results dict. Call _build_plan(results). Merge data from ok responses. Return SkillResponse(skill_name=self.name, data={'tasks': merged_data, 'calendar': results.get('calendar', {}).data if results.get('calendar') and results['calendar'].ok else {}, 'routines': results.get('routines', {}).data if results.get('routines') and results['routines'].ok else {}, 'bills': results.get('bills', {}).data if results.get('bills') and results['bills'].ok else {}}, summary=plan_summary, confidence=0.9, sources=['daily_task_planner']). try/except, on error return SkillResponse with error.

Review. CRITICAL: execute is 'async def'. _run_skill is 'async def'. All .run() calls use 'await'. No database imports. Summary never empty. If no tasks: 'No tasks for today - enjoy your free time!' ASCII only. Production-ready.
